products.name: Nivis Labs Korean Moon Light Night Cream
products.subtitle: Nivis Labs Korean Moon Light Night Cream is a deeply nourishing overnight treatment formulated to repair and restore skin health while you sleep. Powered by advanced ingredients like Lotus PDRN, Cica Exosomes, Ceramide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Shea Butter, and Niacinamide, this rich cream provides deep hydration, strengthens the skin barrier, and improves skin elasticity. Wake up to smooth, radiant, and intensely hydrated skin every morning.

products.name: Nivis Glow Face Serum
products.subtitle: Nivis Glow Face Serum is a luxurious Korean-inspired skincare formula designed to hydrate, brighten, and refresh the skin. Enriched with Triple Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, PDRN, and a Seaweed & Algae Complex, this advanced serum helps replenish moisture, improve the appearance of dull and uneven skin, and support a smoother, healthier-looking complexion. Its premium Luxury Sea Science formulation delivers a lightweight, refreshing skincare experience for naturally radiant-looking skin.
